ski: A system moves into the Washington Cascades Monday with the snow level ~5,500 ft, and Wednesday turns dry. Snow coming: Mt Baker gets 4 in at 4,294 ft and the Mount Baker and Artist Point backcountry 12 in at 5,742 ft by Thursday, NWAC has no rating posted. Best ski day: North Cascades Highway on Monday, good weather window until about 8 PM, then heavy snow, NWAC has no rating posted.
hike: Dry weather holds in most of the mountains today, and a system brings rain and mountain snow Monday with the snow level ~5,500 ft. Best hike day: Blewett Pass on Monday, good weather window until about 8 PM, then rain, NWAC has no rating posted.
